reviews.title: Buggy battery hog
reviews.text: Absolutely kills my iphone battery and makes the phone hot to the touch. If you try to turn the screen off and just use the watch app, the phone app will log you out and lock up the watch app. Very hard to use for an hour unless you brought a charger to the gym.

reviews.title: Very buggy
reviews.text: Very buggy. The video gets stuck and then the app doesn’t move forward. You have to skip sets to get everything back on track—sometimes abandon a workout and then start again. Also it doesn’t consistently save my weights. If I didn’t get this for free with my credit card I would definitely cancel. Not worth the frustration.

reviews.title: apple watch tracking issues
reviews.text: new app doesnt work on apple watch

reviews.title: Regressions not being tested
reviews.text:
With recent updates the app has regressed and now it doesn’t store the auth token on full closure from the recents menu and constantly asks for login. Also the auth form fields do not work well with password managers like Bitwarden anymore. 
It would be nice that you perform E2E testing when releasing new features to make sure fixed bugs are not reintroduced

reviews.title: Overall needs work
reviews.text: I find the different equipments lacking. Also when creating a work out, it still selects machines you don’t have after changing it.

reviews.title: So bad
reviews.text: Bad bad bad. Just bugs everywhere.

reviews.title: bait and switch / fraud
reviews.text: peloton has started throttling regular classes to force users to upgrade to the next tier which is double the price and appears to be using an algorithm to do it. in recent weeks suddenly many of the regular strength classes by my favorite instructors on the app are marked as "exclusive" ie you have to upgrade to another tier at more than twice the price - but here is the kicker - the "exclusive " throttling on those classes is ONLY during periods when i normally work out . when i open the app at other times say 4 pm instead of my usual workout time of 9 am those same classes are all available . also exclusive classes used to be rare and like "here's a workout to beyonces new album" not every day . the new practice is fraudulent deception bait and switch. it is like ordering at chipotle and seeing the prices and then the cashier saying at check out actually if you want your burrito no it is $30 more .

reviews.title: Abandoned App !
reviews.text:
As of the time of writing, it’s been 10 months since its last development !

Honestly at first look, I loved it. But it lacks the continuous improvement that I would’ve expected.
The experience of going through a plan and working out is not optimal.
Not sure if it’s worth it.

They definitely got some parts right, but missed the others in a big way.

1. I like seeing a video of the movement as I’m preforming it
2. I like there art AI generated and also user generated plans
2. I like swiping and having rest.

What I would like to see:
1. Rest should be customizable per movement
2. Rest should be there between blocks too
3. Whenever I stop the plan in going through, it should automatically save my weights, regardless of weather I finished the plan or not.
4. Fix big weights not saved
5. AI generated weights are confusing.
6. No weights recommendations based on my history and fitness level.
7. I should be able to add a custom movement if I want to

reviews.title: Fix the glitches
reviews.text: A nice addition to the main Peloton app, however consistently glitches which is quite frustrating. While you can enjoy your own playlist via phone streaming, whenever I go to Apple Music to select a new song/playlist (or any other app- ie text message, phone, etc) the Strength+ app restarts what I assume is another workout embedded under my current workout. I can continue, however I get dings to continue “other” workout on my Apple Watch and phone for the rest of my session. This has been an ongoing problem. I hope they can fix it.

reviews.title: Nice to have, not necessary
reviews.text: Can’t say this does AI strength programming any different than any other app, which is disappointing. Also, no iPad app is a bit poor for a premium service. I will not be renewing. Not to say it is bad, just know it’s not exceptional

reviews.title: Connect
reviews.text: This is fine, but it really needs to be able to connect to something like a peloton tread or bike or whatever peloton equipment we have that has a screen. If I have an account, I should be able to see this workout on my peloton

reviews.title: Need more equipment
reviews.text: Need cable machine exercises in the app. These exercises I need tracking for the most out of all exercises

reviews.title: App disconnects from iPhone consistently
reviews.text: App is great for workouts but consistently displays a “disconnected from iPhone” notification, so does not accurately track the workout or calories burned. I’ve tried updating the app and my phone and do not see any differences. I also have done troubleshooting online and none of the remedies work. The developers need to address this.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: Messes up my metrics by not ending my workouts until I force close the Apple Watch app

reviews.title: Beyond frustrating
reviews.text: Any time I’ve attempted to create a custom workout, the entire app freezes when I go to name it and everything is lost.

reviews.title: Kind of a joke
reviews.text: Only 2 dumbbell programs. I thought peloton was supposed to be for people that work out at home. I realize you can swap but it should offer a similar exercise not every exercise peloton can imagine.

reviews.title: Long peleton fan- disappointed
reviews.text: Glitchy

reviews.title: Good app but to buggy
reviews.text: Great functionality, but it logs me out randomly even just minutes after finishing a work out.

reviews.title: Works for some things, but…
reviews.text: A lot of the pre done workouts are OK, though some of them have weird glitches on circuits and reps. Became clear why when building my own workout in app and the circuit function (supersets) is completely broken, making many workouts impossible to build

reviews.title: It’s extremely basic
reviews.text:
The workouts are fine. They tend to repeat or be so similar that you don’t need the app. 
The user interface is lacking. It’s not easy to switch or skip sets. 
The timing issue with workouts doesn’t make sense. I’ll skip the rest periods and still end up over time for the work out length. 
It seems to me that this app is created by people that don’t workout.

reviews.title: No more heart rate
reviews.text: The new update does not allow for heart rate tracking with the Apple Watch, very bummed about this. Will likely stop using the watch app now

reviews.title: Frustrating UI
reviews.text: It’s so difficult to track your weights. If you forget to enter the weights during the workout and press “finish” then you can’t edit. You can’t see the log of weights you lifted last time once you start a workout, only if you select the exercise before starting. Worthless as a tracker if I can’t log or review progress.

reviews.title: ipad won’t sync with heart rate on apple watch
reviews.text: iPad won’t sync with Apple Watch during workout. It makes you want to have to use your iPhone with peloton strength rather than peloton strength on the iPad please fix.

reviews.title: Can’t sign in
reviews.text:
Peloton’s username/password login is messed up when signed up with Google SSO.

This app doesn’t allow SSO login so i can’t login

reviews.title: Try Ladder instead
reviews.text: This is an okay app for people who don’t want to think about what exercises to do. However, you’d expect better from Peloton at $10/mo. I’d suggest trying the Ladder app instead - way better classes / routines and value.

reviews.title: Good be great
reviews.text: This app is pretty good to use, and makes some killer workouts.  However it constantly deletes my previous data and resets the exercise so I have no idea the previous reps or weight used.  The watch app can also be gimmicky and have issues connecting. Fix the memory so I don’t have to use two apps to track my workouts

reviews.title: Too fast
reviews.text: I really thought this would replace another app. I have relating to fitness training. Perhaps I don’t know how to use it but the space between workouts is super quick and I have no time to enter the the way I was using. I had hoped the app would learn from the weights I was using perhaps letting me know what weight to use next time. Had to stop using the app about halfway through my first workout.

reviews.title: Limited
reviews.text: Just so far behind other applications in this category.  Want to reorder lifts while in your workout, nope. Want to see what your weights are for the next lift while in your break, 6 taps there and back. Want to change the contents in your saved day without actually starting the lift, nope.

reviews.title: Programs never save progress
reviews.text:
After completing any class after the first in a program the progress is never saved to the program. So the app always thinks the next class is the second regardless of how many have been completed. The user profile does reflect the completed class but not the containing program. 

This has been happening for months and months.
